summary: A cardholder makes purchases within the credit limit, receives a monthly statement, and then makes a payment after the due date that is smaller than the required minimum. The scenario is designed to exercise the late-payment path where the minimum payment obligation is not satisfied on time despite a partial payment being posted later.
assumptions: The billing cycle closes on 2025-03-31 and produces a periodic statement with a New Balance of 600.00 USD.
Under clause.5.minimum_payment_formula, the minimum payment on a 600.00 USD New Balance is 18.00 USD (3% of 600.00), which is greater than 15.00 USD.
The payment due date shown on the statement is 2025-04-25.
No prior unpaid fees, returned payments, disputes, or skip-payment arrangements affect this cycle.
The purchase in this scenario remains within the 1000.00 USD credit limit, so the credit-limit obligation is treated as met.

A payment event is still included with clause.5.minimum_payment_obligation even though it is late and below the required minimum; this is intentional so the executor can evaluate that the obligation was attempted but remains unmet for this archetype.
